description: Use when you need the Canadian business day a count lands on, or to check whether a date is a business day. Moves a start date forward 0 to 260 business days on the Payments Canada calendar and names each closure day passed. $0.01 USDC on Base per answer via x402; a refusal is free.

business_days.description: business days to move forward, 0 to 260; 0 moves a day that is not a business day to the next one

start_date.description: a real calendar date in a year the calendar covers; it may be a weekend or a closure day

name: add-business-days-to-date
title: Add business days to date
